name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: One month of days to pick one from: the date grid of a booking page, a date field's popup, a "when" step. Days are plain `YYYY-MM-DD` strings (see `calendar-model`), so the day a reader picks is the day the server stores, in every time zone.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/calendar

Installed to `components/ui/calendar.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/calendar';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/calendar

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
